description: This file defines data models and configuration structures related to the Azure Prompt Shield guardrail within a content safety system. It contains TypedDict definitions for request and response bodies, as well as a configuration model class with a static method for UI representation.

classes.name: AzurePromptShieldGuardrailRequestBody
classes.description: TypedDict for configuration parameters for the Azure Prompt Shield guardrail, including user prompt and documents.

classes.name: UserPromptAnalysis
classes.description: Optional TypedDict indicating whether an attack was detected in user prompt analysis.

classes.name: AzurePromptShieldGuardrailResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for response data, including user prompt analysis results and document analysis.

classes.name: AzurePromptShieldGuardrailConfigModel
classes.description: A class that extends configuration models, representing the Azure Content Safety Prompt Shield configuration with a static method for UI display.

methods.name: str ui_friendly_name()
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the guardrail configuration, 'Azure Content Safety Prompt Shield'.
